test_case: Phantom Brew whitebox flows › cart coupon applies a visible discount to the order total
estimated_root_cause: Add to Cart on /menu/1 did not update cart state; badge stayed 0 before coupon flow started.
recommended_action: Debug add-to-cart handler/state sync on product detail page and verify badge increments after click.

test_case: 注文ステータスページ › ステータスが「preparing」に進む
estimated_root_cause: Status progression is time/random-delay driven and did not advance from received within the test window.
recommended_action: Poll/wait for eventual state or control/mock the status timer instead of asserting immediate progression.

test_case: 注文ステータスページ › 最終的にステータスが「completed」になる
estimated_root_cause: Order status never progressed at all; it remained received for 15s instead of reaching completed.
recommended_action: Investigate status transition logic/background updates from received to preparing/completed.

test_case: レート制限テスト › 通常のページ遷移でエラーが出ない
estimated_root_cause: Assertion uses multi-match selector 'h1, .product-card' with toBeVisible, causing Playwright strict mode failure.
recommended_action: Use a single specific locator or assert count/any-visible explicitly.
